target.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes
target.body:
Closes #107707

## What Problem This Solves

`applySkillProposal` in the Skill Workshop wrote stripped proposal content directly to SKILL.md with no body validation. Plan or change-description proposals could silently overwrite real skill content, and the default `approvalPolicy` change to `auto` (PR #107690) removed the human review gate that previously caught these cases. This is the canonical apply-boundary fix for #107707; the merged generation-side hardening (PR #108339) explicitly left apply-side validation unresolved.

## Why This Change Was Made

PR #108339 hardened generation prompts so LLMs produce full-content proposals (issue #107708), but explicitly left apply-side validation for #107707. Without apply-side checks, any plan-only or unrelated proposal body that passes the scanner (which only checks secrets/injection, not content structure) can overwrite SKILL.md. The initial patch used heading-presence and any-line-overlap heuristics, but Codex review identified that (1) heading checks block valid headingless skills, (2) any-line overlap is trivially bypassable — a plan document sharing a single heading or boilerplate line receives `requiresExplicitApproval=false` and overwrites the skill, and (3) zero-overlap hard rejection leaves no path for intentional complete rewrites.

The current fix validates proposed content through the canonical `parseFrontmatter` parser, rejects empty bodies, and uses a **substantial-continuity classifier** that requires at least 3 shared non-heading body lines AND at least 50% of original non-heading content retained before allowing automatic apply. Low-continuity updates force pending approval even under `auto` policy, preserving an explicit replacement path for intentional complete rewrites while blocking incidental-overlap plans that share only headings or 1-2 boilerplate lines.

## User Impact

- Empty proposal bodies are hard-rejected with a descriptive error; SKILL.md remains unchanged
- Proposals without valid SKILL.md frontmatter (plan documents, change descriptions) are hard-rejected; SKILL.md remains unchanged
- Low-continuity update proposals (insufficient shared content with current SKILL.md) are forced through pending approval even under `auto` policy, instead of being silently auto-applied
- Substantially continuous updates (≥3 shared non-heading lines, ≥50% original content retained) apply normally without requiring explicit approval
- Valid headingless skill updates apply normally when they retain substantial content
- Valid updates with shared content display a bounded change summary (`+N lines, -M lines`) in approval descriptions and apply results
- Rollback data (`previousContent`) is recorded in `rollback.json` for all successful applies

**Maintainer decision needed**: The low-continuity approval override changes the recently established automatic approval policy (PR #107690). This conditional exception requires explicit maintainer confirmation from shakkernerd (who introduced the automatic approval behavior). Options: (1) Keep the safety exception — require explicit approval only for low-continuity updates while substantially continuous updates continue using automatic approval (recommended). (2) Preserve unconditional automatic approval — reject structurally invalid proposals but allow all structurally valid updates to retain automatic approval. (3) Require approval for every update — simpler safety rule but more workflow regression.

## Evidence

**Real environment**: Linux, Node v24.13.1, **exact head SHA `b50fd7ca78`**

**Approval-hook proof: auto policy blocks low-continuity writes while allowing high-continuity updates**

The `resolveSkillWorkshopToolApproval` function is the approval hook that determines whether an agent-initiated `apply` action proceeds automatically or requires operator approval. Under `auto` policy, it returns `undefined` (no approval required) for actions that pass all checks. For low-continuity updates, it returns `requireApproval` with a warning prompt, which blocks the agent from applying the proposal until the operator approves. SKILL.md remains unchanged until approval is granted.

```
Test: resolveSkillWorkshopToolApproval > requires approval for low-continuity updates under auto policy

Low-continuity update (unrelated rewrite, zero shared non-heading lines):
  resolveSkillWorkshopToolApproval returns requireApproval:
    title: "Apply workspace skill proposal"
    severity: "warning"
    timeoutMs: 70000
    allowedDecisions: ["allow-once", "deny"]
  → Agent cannot auto-apply; SKILL.md stays unchanged until operator approves

High-continuity update (4 of 6 shared non-heading lines, 67% retained):
  resolveSkillWorkshopToolApproval returns undefined
  → Agent can auto-apply; normal workflow continues
```

**Incidental-overlap regression proof (exact head SHA `b50fd7ca78`)**:

The substantial-continuity classifier blocks all three incidental-overlap variants that previously bypassed approval:

```
Original SKILL.md body (non-heading lines):
  "Steps to check weather.", "Check the forecast.", "Save the result." (3 lines)

Heading-only overlap (shares "# Weather" heading, no non-heading overlap):
  overlapCount=0, ratio=0.0 → isSubstantialContinuity=false
  → requiresExplicitApproval=true ✅

1-line overlap (shares "Steps to check weather.", 1/3=33%):
  overlapCount=1, ratio=0.33 → 1<3 && 0.33<0.5 → isSubstantialContinuity=false
  → requiresExplicitApproval=true ✅

2-line overlap (shares "Steps to check weather." + "Check the forecast.", 2/3=67%):
  overlapCount=2, ratio=0.67 → 2<3 → isSubstantialContinuity=false
  → requiresExplicitApproval=true ✅

Substantial continuity (shares 4/6 non-heading lines, 67%):
  overlapCount=4, ratio=0.67 → 4≥3 && 0.67≥0.5 → isSubstantialContinuity=true
  → requiresExplicitApproval=false, auto-apply proceeds ✅
```

**Unit tests (exact head SHA `b50fd7ca78`)**:

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/workshop/apply-body-validation.test.ts src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts --run

 ✓ |unit| src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts (35 tests) 13380ms
 ✓ |unit| src/skills/workshop/apply-body-validation.test.ts (3 tests) 4269ms
     ✓ gates low-continuity updates with requiresExplicitApproval and rejects empty bodies  1749ms
     ✓ gates incidental-overlap plans that share only a heading or few non-heading lines  1678ms
     ✓ applies headingless and substantially continuous updates without requiresExplicitApproval  841ms
 ✓ |unit| src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts (9 tests) 1531ms
     ✓ requires approval for low-continuity updates under auto policy  1019ms

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  47 passed (47)
```

**Validation matrix**:

```
Proposal body form                                        => Result
Empty body (whitespace only)                              => Hard rejection, SKILL.md unchanged
Invalid frontmatter (plan/description only)               => Hard rejection, SKILL.md unchanged
Zero shared non-heading lines (complete rewrite/unrelated) => requiresExplicitApproval=true, forced pending approval
Incidental heading-only overlap (plan shares heading)     => requiresExplicitApproval=true, forced pending approval
Incidental 1-line overlap (plan shares one non-heading)   => requiresExplicitApproval=true, forced pending approval
Incidental 2-line overlap (plan shares two non-heading)   => requiresExplicitApproval=true, forced pending approval
Substantial continuity (≥3 lines, ≥50% retained)          => requiresExplicitApproval=false, auto-apply proceeds
Valid headingless skill with substantial content          => requiresExplicitApproval=false, auto-apply proceeds
```

**CI note**: The `startup-memory` check failure (`status --json` median RSS exceeding 425 MB limit) is a pre-existing issue on the `main` branch, not introduced by this PR.
